newsitem.title: DUBAI: Trade picks up on UAE stock market after holidays.
newsitem.headline: Trade picks up on UAE stock market after holidays.

text.p: The return of major investors from summer holidays boosted trading volumes on the informal United Arab Emirates stock market in the week to Thursday, but prices moved in a tight range, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ended the week 5.09 points higher at 2,339.94 points.

National Dredging Co and Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co lost five dirhams each to a respective 400 and 935 dirhams, while Emirates Insurance, al-Dhafra Insurance and Union National Bank each gained five dirhams to 570, 755 and 295 dirhams respectively.
Dubai Islamic Bank and Etisalat shares were traded in small volumes at 168 and 935 dirhams respectively.
Brokers said big volumes of Dubai Investment Co shares were traded at 14 dirhams, from 13 to 13.5 dirhams last week.
Abu Dhabi Shipbuilding Co shares moved up two dirhams to 32 dirhams. -- Dubai Newsroom +9714-626990
